This is all about letting minimalistic accessories make a statement, like a headscarf for a boat day. I do this gold fish clutch with the fringe detail. If you want one fun pair of shoes, I would do these fish heels from Saad. If there's any place to wear a gladiator sandal, it's Greece, and I love these from Altazara. A caftan is the dress that you should be wearing during the day when you're not going to the beach. I even wear one of these for a night out with some gold accessories. Or a plain matching set like this for dinner and EOS. Something blue with fringe and mykonos. Wear a dress like this to a Greek winery. This is the sunset drinks. Never go wrong with a linen matching set. Anything with a lot of movement, bonus points if it's satin. If you're going to a wedding in Greece, I would definitely wear this gold dress from Zimmerman. Think Greek goddess, not nightclub. If you are going to go out at night, I'd do something with a deep razor back. That's everything I'd wear in Greece this summer. I linked everything and more. The pump doesn't have a battery. It just runs off USB-C, so no airline headaches. Plus, you can actually plug it into your phone to get power, or a power bank, or the wall. It compresses everything into a flat brick, and the seal holds for seven days. Céline Bucket Bag

Le City by Balenciaga

Longchamp Le Pliage

Saint Louis by Goyard

Parisian handbag style is all about balance: practical but elegant, designer but not too flashy, polished but never too perfect.

▪️The 3-Color Rule: Stick to a palette of three colors that play well together.

▪️The 1:3 Ratio: Every hero piece—like a blazer or a pair of boots—must work with three different outfits.

▪️Smart Accessories: Lean on “repeatable” items like a classic neutral belt or a versatile scarf for a pop of color that works with your color palette. 

▪️Play Dress Up: Try on your options while you pack. It’s the only way to really lock in your styling strategy. (Serious packing guru, @heleneisfor, even goes so far to take selfies of each look.)

transcript: Let's rapid fire through the biggest fall handbag trends you are about to see everywhere, starting with croc. Croc embossed leather is going to be huge, adding interest and texture to even the simplest bags, and it feels especially rich for fall. Next we have to talk about oversized shoulder bags. We are moving away from those really structured shapes and towards larger bags in soft leather that have this really relaxed feel. The Chanel maxi flap should be everyone's inspiration. Embroidery is another big one. We're seeing bags with more intricate detail and craftsmanship, which makes them feel really special. It is all about a clutch, but not just for evening. Think larger, more relaxed clutches that can carry you during the day and can be worn with everything from denim to tailoring. We are loving a rounded top handle bag. We're seeing softer curves and rounded shapes that still feel classic, but a little bit more current. The row is doing this really well. Finally, we have to talk about the color burgundy. This is going to be one of the biggest handbag colors for fall, and you should treat it as a neutral. It works with black, brown, gray, camel, denim, literally anything in your fall wardrobe. I have made an edit of all my favorite fall handbags that I have seen so far, so comment below if you'd like to shop.
